scopeNotice: Sophaxis is not offered where a law requires, or is reported to require, a service offered to people there to have a representative there, to keep personal data there, to register there, or to meet conditions before personal data leaves the place that Sophaxis cannot meet. From 2026-11-22 Sophaxis does not list work by an author who lives in any of these places. This depends only on where an author lives, not on nationality, race, ethnic origin or any other personal characteristic: an author of any nationality who lives elsewhere can submit. The laws include Article 27 of the GDPR and of the UK GDPR, Article 13 of the EU Digital Services Act, Article 53 of China's Personal Information Protection Law, section 37(5) of Thailand's Personal Data Protection Act, and Article 18(5) of Russia's Federal Law No. 152-FZ. Sophaxis, run unpaid by one person within free services, has no representative anywhere and keeps no data in any of these places.

termsNotice.text: A person under 13 can no longer submit. A work with more than one author is listed only after every other author confirms their own agreement. Text written in the forms is shared under CC0 1.0, and an abstract given in a form under the licence of the work. The submission form asks two more confirmations: that every author consents to the record being published, offered through OAI-PMH and provided to services in the United States, and agreement to the policies. The form also asks for the extent of use of generative models, at one of four levels: none, editing, assistance or drafting. From 2026-11-22, a work is listed only if no author lives in a place where Sophaxis is not offered, as the Submission Policy lists them, or an author under 18 lives in India, and the form asks the submitter to confirm it. The saves to the Internet Archive become a separate box that may be left empty. Confirming something untrue in a form is not allowed; from 2026-11-22, the operator may decline further submissions from the account that did so.
